batch.description: Filter by YC batch code. 'any' returns every batch. Codes: S=Summer, W=Winter, F=Fall followed by two-digit year (e.g. S24 = Summer 2024).
batch.title: Batch

directoryUrl.description: Y Combinator company directory URL. Default scrapes the full directory. You can paste a filtered URL (e.g. https://www.ycombinator.com/companies?batch=S24&industry=AI).
directoryUrl.title: Directory URL

highlightBlackFounders.description: If true, only return companies flagged as having Black founders. Requires the signal to be present on Algolia — companies without the flag are not fabricated.
highlightBlackFounders.title: Highlight: Black Founders

highlightHispanicFounders.description: If true, only return companies flagged as having Hispanic / Latino founders. Requires the signal to be present on Algolia.
highlightHispanicFounders.title: Highlight: Hispanic / Latino Founders

highlightWomenFounders.description: If true, only return companies flagged as having women founders. Requires the signal to be present on Algolia.
highlightWomenFounders.title: Highlight: Women Founders

industry.description: Filter by industry (e.g. 'B2B', 'Consumer', 'Fintech', 'Healthcare', 'Industrials', 'Real Estate and Construction'). Case-sensitive, exact match against YC's industry facets.
industry.title: Industry

maxItems.description: Maximum number of companies to return.
maxItems.title: Max Items

query.description: Optional free-text query. When set, filters the directory using the ?q=<query> Algolia search (matches name, description, tags).
query.title: Search Query

regions.description: Optional region filter (case-insensitive substring match against the company's location). Example: ["San Francisco", "New York"].
regions.title: Regions

scrapeFounders.description: Include each company's founders (name, title, bio, LinkedIn, Twitter). Requires an extra detail-page fetch per company.
scrapeFounders.title: Scrape Founders

scrapeOpenJobs.description: Include each company's open job postings (title, URL, location, salary, equity, skills, visa). Shares the same detail-page fetch as founders.
scrapeOpenJobs.title: Scrape Open Jobs

status.description: Filter by company operating status. 'any' returns all statuses.
status.title: Status

tags.description: Optional tag filter (case-insensitive). Matched against industry, subIndustry and any tag arrays Algolia returns. Example: ["B2B", "Fintech"].
tags.title: Tags
